title: Spark SQL: Relational Data Processing in Spark
authors: Michael Armbrust, Reynold S. Xin, Cheng Lian, Yin Huai, Davies Liu, Joseph K. Bradley, Xiangrui Meng, Tomer Kaftan, Michael J. Franklin, Ali Ghodsi, Matei Zaharia
description: Spark SQL integrates relational processing into Apache Spark through a declarative DataFrame API and the Catalyst extensible optimizer, enabling seamless mixing of SQL queries with procedural Spark programs over diverse data sources.
